name: MMA-SGD: Momentum + Anchor
tagline: Meta-SGD per-parameter LRs combined with per-layer learnable momentum and an elastic pull toward the meta-init.
init_recovers: Meta-SGD when β=γ=0; MAML if also α≡INNER_LR.
diff_from_baseline: Augments Meta-SGD's per-parameter LR with two extra meta-learned per-layer scalars: a sigmoid momentum coefficient β (heavy-ball EMA on gradients) and a sigmoid anchoring γ that elastically pulls each parameter back toward the meta-initialization — neither of MAML, Meta-SGD or ANIL has momentum or proximal anchoring.

name: Factorized Meta-SGD + Step Decay
tagline: Per-param LRs as outer × inner channel-factor exp-scales, per-tensor learnable momentum β=σ(b), and a global step-wise LR decay.
init_recovers: Vanilla MAML when factors = 1 (a=0), β = 0, ψ = 1.
diff_from_baseline: Compared to Meta-SGD's full per-element LR (one tensor per param), the LR is replaced by a memory-efficient factorized exp(a_out) ⊗ exp(a_in) per layer and combined with a learned per-tensor momentum β=σ(b) and a global geometric step-decay ψ^t — none of MAML/Meta-SGD/ANIL factorize LRs or decay them through the inner loop.

name: Proximal Meta-Momentum (PMM)
tagline: Meta-SGD plus per-layer learnable heavy-ball momentum and a softplus-bounded proximal anchor on the meta-init.
diff_from_baseline: Adds two meta-learned per-tensor scalars on top of Meta-SGD: a sigmoid-bounded momentum β=σ(b) for heavy-ball gradient EMA and a softplus-bounded proximal weight γ=softplus(c) that explicitly penalises drift from the meta-initialisation w⁰ — Meta-SGD lacks momentum, ANIL freezes the backbone, MAML has neither.

name: Layerwise-Gated Meta-SGD
tagline: Meta-SGD per-param LRs multiplied by a learned per-tensor sigmoid gate, biased high for the head and low for the backbone.
init_recovers: ANIL-like behaviour at init (only head adapts effectively); collapses to Meta-SGD if all gates → 1.
diff_from_baseline: A soft, fully meta-learned interpolation between Meta-SGD and ANIL: every parameter still has its own LR vector, but each tensor gets one extra learnable sigmoid gate biased to start ANIL-like (head ≈0.88×, backbone ≈0.12×) — Meta-SGD has no gating, ANIL is a hard zero/one mask.

name: LAMO: Per-param LR + Norm-Stabilised Momentum
tagline: Meta-SGD per-parameter LRs with a fixed-β EMA on direction-normalised gradients, then re-scaled by the original gradient norm.
diff_from_baseline: Adds a non-meta-learned momentum (β=0.9) on top of Meta-SGD; the EMA acts only on the gradient direction (g/‖g‖) and the parameter step is then re-scaled by the original ‖g‖, decoupling direction-smoothing from magnitude — Meta-SGD has no momentum, MAML has neither LR vectors nor momentum.
